transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?
I've just been feeling incredibly depressed and sad for the past two weeks. There's this constant feeling of emptiness inside me, like I'm completely hollow. I just don't know what to do anymore.
Have you ever had periods lasting several days where you felt the exact opposite—like you had unusually high energy, needed very little sleep, or felt extremely active and on top of the world?
No, I've never experienced anything like that or had that kind of high energy. I've only ever felt really down, depressed, and completely drained.
During this difficult time, have you heard voices or seen things that others couldn't, or held beliefs that other people found unusual or hard to believe?

Yes, I have. Lately, I've been hearing faint whispers when no one is around, and I can't shake the terrifying feeling that people are constantly watching and plotting against me. These things only started happening since I began feeling so deeply depressed.
Have you ever experienced these whispers or the feeling of being watched during times when you were not feeling depressed or down?
No, I only hear those whispers and feel watched when I am feeling deeply depressed. When my mood is normal, I don't experience those things at all.

They also report auditory hallucinations and persecutory delusions that occur exclusively during these depressive periods, which rules out Schizophrenia and Schizoaffective Disorder (Depressive Type), where psychotic symptoms must occur in the absence of mood symptoms. This leaves Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features as the definitive diagnosis.
